description: Recording on an Android mobile-web context (issue #1007). The device browser session is both the recorder and the host that tracks the recording, so the recording handle and the session point at each other. The fixture jobs run at `logLevel: debug`, where the runner logs every step result as JSON, so a handle left on the step result crashed the context with a circular-structure error. One test per way a recording starts: an authored `record` step, and `autoRecord`. On every incapable host the android preflight lands the context SKIPPED. The pages are served by the job's test server on the HOST at port 8092; from the emulator the host loopback is 10.0.2.2.

tests.description: An authored `record` step records the device screen around a click, and `stopRecord` saves it.

`autoRecord` starts the device recording before the first authored step, and the end-of-context sweep saves it. The page has no viewport meta on purpose. While a recording runs, a navigation re-injects the synthetic cursor at its earlier position, and on a page that narrows the viewport that pointer move lands out of bounds and crashes the context. That's a separate bug from #1007.
